messages:
leo_sales: Dropped KiteBridge security bundle into the shared drive and opened intake. CAIQ export + short note about keys. link: https://drive.google.com/kitebridge-packet :paperclip:
maya_security: grabbing now. quick Q: did they explicitly request BYOK for the POC or just for production?
leo_sales: intake form says 'customer-managed keys preferred for all environments' but they also said 'flexible for demo'. ambiguous.
deployment-bot: Ticket created: RWI-5010 \u2014 security-intake. Assigned to maya_security.
maya_security: i'll triage. initial required evidence list: KMS vendor & ARNs, key rotation policy, SOC2 PDF, and POC data classification (any PII?).
clare_customer: (customer) Hi team 1 we can provide AWS KMS ARNs and the SOC2 PDF. For the POC we prefer BYOK but can accept hosted KMS if timeline is tight.
ben_ops: ops note: if BYOK and AWS KMS ARNs provided we can attach keys for a demo within one business day. non-AWS vendors will need extra platform time.
maya_security: posting checklist for RWI-5010: 
```
- KMS ARNs + key policy
- Confirm if PII is included in POC (Y/N)
- SOC2 cert + scope
- Redacted pen test summary or attestation
- Network diagram for any on-prem connections
```
leo_sales: asked customer to confirm PII status and send ARNs by EOD (48h).
clare_customer: replied: "No PII in demo. Sending ARNs and SOC2 now." :thumbsup:
maya_security: great. i'll validate ARNs and SOC2 scope and update ticket. if all good, mark as ready for ops.
ben_ops: once validated we need a 2-hour maintenance window to attach keys and verify logs. estimate for POC setup: 0.5 engineer-days.
leo_sales: i'll update commercial thread with timing and potential cost delta for dedicated vs hosted demo.
maya_security: will also add a short security note for the quote: BYOK requires customer-provided ARNs and a key rotation policy; otherwise we recommend hosted demo with documented residual risk.
clare_customer: thanks everyone, will stand by for scheduling.
